errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the starting point and its value. The first data point for TF-IDF is before x=50 at approximately y=81.1%. At x=50, the value is approximately 82.6%, not 81.2%.
For the TF-IDF line, the accuracy at a dimension of 100 is approximately 83.75%, not 82.2%.
For the TF-IDF line, the accuracy at a dimension of 150 is approximately 84.05%, not 82.8%.
For the TF-IDF line, the accuracy at a dimension of 200 is approximately 84.1%, not 83.5%.

The description incorrectly identifies the starting point and its value for the MFDSL line. The first data point is before x=50 at approximately y=81.9%. At x=50, the value is much higher, around 83.9%.
For the MFDSL line, the accuracy at a dimension of 100 is approximately 84.05%, not 83.2%.

The description incorrectly states that the MFDSL line briefly decreases at a dimension of 150. The plot shows the line continues to rise slightly or stays flat. Additionally, the value at this point is approximately 84.1%, not 83.6%.
For the MFDSL line, the accuracy at a dimension of 200 is approximately 84.1%, not 83.8%.
